name: correlate_static_and_runtime
description: Evaluate every explicit caller-declared hypothesis between static and runtime comparison Evidence supplied inline or by exact retained-evidence references. Similar names or paths are never auto-matched, consistent cochange never proves causality, and unknown or truncated inputs remain unresolved. Returns all correlations and their complete Evidence closure inline.
